_comment: Advisories the frontend dependency gate (tools/check_npm_audit.py) tolerates. Every entry needs a rationale and an expiry; an expired entry fails the gate. Remove an entry as soon as a fix exists.

advisories.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs in picomatch <= 4.0.7. No patched release exists: 4.0.7 is the latest, and npm audit's only proposed fix is a major downgrade of vite and vitest. Reached only as a transitive dependency of vite, vitest and tinyglobby, which match this repository's own config and source globs at build and test time. The glob patterns involved are this repository's own configuration; whether a crafted file or request path could trigger it through the dev server was not assessed, and the dev server is local-only. Nothing from the chain ships in the dashboard bundle or runs in the desktop app. Remove this entry and update the lockfile as soon as a fixed picomatch is published.
